description: Recall evidence for a focused question; follow up with narrower queries as needed. Returns engine JSON with project_id and memory_id handles, source metadata, and requested diagnostics in text and structuredContent. Use handles with cuemap_memory_get when the stored record is needed. Hybrid locally reranks lexical candidates. Start with a small limit and depth 1; enable reconstruction only when surrounding evidence is needed.

auto_reinforce.description: Automatically reinforce retrieved memories. Default is false.

cuebridge_gap_limit.description: Maximum CueBridge gap expansions. Default is 6.

cues.description: Normally omit: CueMap generates cues from the query. Supply known tags only to deliberately narrow lexical/hybrid recall, e.g. type:conversation to search tagged conversations.

depth.description: Depth of multi-hop recall. Default is 1.

disable_alias_expansion.description: Disable alias expansion during querying. Default is true.

disable_cuebridge_artifacts.description: Disable CueBridge artifact expansion. Default is false.

disable_salience_bias.description: Disable salience bias scoring. Default is false.

evidence_coverage.description: Evidence coverage mode for multi-evidence answers. Default is off.

evidence_coverage_limit.description: Result scan limit for evidence coverage. Default is 100.

evidence_coverage_max_sessions.description: Maximum sessions considered for evidence coverage. Default is 3.

evidence_coverage_session_scan_limit.description: Per-session scan limit for evidence coverage. Default is 4096.

expansion_depth.description: Neighbor context expansion. 1 returns the matched chunk; values above 1 include nearby parent chunks or source-ordered context with radius expansion_depth - 1 when linkage exists. "conversation_round" prepends the message each result replies to (for an assistant reply, the user message that prompted it) and appends the answer to the top result when memories carry session, turn and role metadata. Default is "conversation_round"; memories without that metadata are returned as they are.

explain.description: Include explain component for debug information in results. Default is false.

limit.description: Optional limit on the number of results to return. Default is 10.

min_intersection.description: Minimum intersection count for retrieval. Default is 0.

ordered_max_sessions.description: Maximum sessions considered for ordered reconstruction. Default is 3.

ordered_reconstruction.description: Ordered session reconstruction mode. Default is off.

ordered_reconstruction_limit.description: Result scan limit for ordered reconstruction. Default is 80.

ordered_session_scan_limit.description: Per-session scan limit for ordered reconstruction. Default is 4096.

parent_fusion.description: Parent fusion mode for chunk-parent reconstruction. Default is off.

parent_fusion_limit.description: Candidate limit for parent fusion. Default is 80.

parent_fusion_min_chunks.description: Minimum sibling chunks required for parent fusion. Default is 2.

preview_chars.description: Maximum leading content length per hit in preview mode (100–2000 UTF-16 code units; default 200). Does not cap metadata or diagnostics. Ignored in full mode.

projects.description: Optional list of project IDs to scope the search to. Provide multiple for cross-project recall. If not provided, searches the default project.

query.description: The natural language query to search the codebase memory for.

query_embedding.description: Optional precomputed query vector. Use this when the application owns the embedding provider.

query_time.description: Optional timestamp or natural-language time anchor used by v0.7 temporal query intent.

response_mode.description: Default full. Use preview for broad discovery to return only a leading excerpt per hit, with IDs and source metadata. Fetch promising stored memories with cuemap_memory_get; previews are not complete evidence.

semantic_mode.description: Query signal mode. lexical uses cue recall only, semantic uses vector candidate discovery, and hybrid reranks lexical candidates. Default is hybrid.

trace_timing.description: Include v0.7 timing diagnostics in the response. Default is false.

name: cuemap_recall
